# Quantum Thermometry Feedback — reading routes

Canonical question: sharp global minimax log-temperature risk under exactly two batches of fully equilibrated Gibbs probes with one classical feedback update and a pathwise N-qubit budget.

Main result: R_2^*(N)=Theta(N^(-3/2)); r-round lower bound only for general fixed r, exponent 2-2^(1-r). No general matching r>2 hierarchy claimed.

START: README.md — central question, limits and short result table.
MODEL: science/model.md — replacement contract, energy-label sufficiency, allowed feedback, charged resources and loss.
THERMAL FOUNDATION: science/entropy_budget.md — Gibbs FI, entropy-area bound and universal pointwise heat-capacity bound.
CORE CONVERSE: science/two_batch_converse.md — posterior density supremum, exact posterior Fisher identity, second-stage area, van Trees global risk.
CORE CONSTRUCTION: science/achievability.md — fixed-gap pilot, tuned degenerate blocks, smoothed-logit lemma, rare-error exponential moment.
SECONDARY THEOREM: science/round_complexity.md — fixed-r lower bound; only necessity of Omega(log log N) feedback rounds for global N^(-2).
PHYSICAL READING: science/interpretation.md — sensitivity height/bandwidth, memory model, thermalization-time and Hamiltonian engineering qualifications.
NOVELTY/ATTRIBUTION: references/RELATED_WORK.md — credited global Bayesian results, Mehboudi et al. 2022 closest comparator, new 2026 literature access gap, internal portfolio comparison.
BIBLIOGRAPHY: references/references.bib — primary sources.
REPRODUCE: verification/README.md — commands, scoped numerical checks and omitted probability tails.

Do not conflate local Fisher sensitivity with uniform global error, Gibbs qubit uses with elapsed time, or a converse-only r-round result with matching attainment. The primary source of mathematical statements is science/, not this guide. This is not a personalized coaching document.
